title: Boca Juniors vs Unión de Santa Fe
subtitle: Match valid for the 11th round of the Argentine Championship - Clausura 2026
excerpt: Boca Juniors and Unión de Santa Fe face off this Friday at 21:30, at the Bombonera. Check where to watch and lineups.
author: Daniele Morais
trending: boca juniors x unión de santa fe
contentHtml:
Boca Juniors and Unión de Santa Fe face off this Friday at 21:30, at the Bombonera, in a match valid for the 11th round of the Argentine Championship - Clausura 2026. Boca Juniors comes into the match on a good recent run, while Unión seeks to regain consistency in the tournament after inconsistent results in the last rounds.

what's at stake

The match pits teams against each other that are looking to consolidate their position at the top of the table. Boca Juniors currently occupies 5th place, with 17 points, and wants a win in front of their fans to close in on the leading pack. Meanwhile, Unión de Santa Fe appears in 9th place, with 13 points, trying to achieve a victory away from home to reduce the four-point disadvantage over their Buenos Aires rival and move up positions in the tournament.

where to watch

The match between Boca Juniors and Unión de Santa Fe will be broadcast in Brazil. TV: ESPN; Streaming: Disney+.

lineups

Boca Juniors is expected to take the field with a team similar to the one that recently beat Racing for the Argentine Cup. The only doubt concerns the dispute between Leonel Flores and Sebastián Villa for a spot in the starting lineup. Meanwhile, Unión de Santa Fe is expected to adopt a defensive posture, seeking to surprise in counter-attacks.

head-to-head history

Boca Juniors has the upper hand in the overall record against Unión, with 24 wins, 15 draws, and only 9 losses for the Santa Fe club. However, in the last 10 meetings, Unión has a slight advantage, with 3 wins against 2 for Boca, in addition to 5 draws.

With information from OneFootball, 365Scores.
